verdict.rationale: Adyen Issuing offers transaction rules that automatically approve or decline card authorizations, plus configurable fallback logic (default approval or refusal) when relayed authorisation gets no reply within 2000 ms. These are real rule-driven automatic actions, but only on the authorization event and only for approve/decline outcomes. Other events (configuration, transfer, dispute, balance, network token) are delivered as webhooks, so any wider automation has to be built on your own servers. Missing for 10: a general event-to-action rule engine beyond authorization decisions, documented rule criteria/syntax depth, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
